lock-hydraulics.title: 船閘水理設計手冊
lock-hydraulics.titleEn: Hydraulic Design of Navigation Locks EM1110-2-1604
lock-hydraulics.scope: 官方書目確認二〇〇六年五月手冊及船閘水理範圍；不把水理手冊當成閘門結構規範。
lock-hydraulics.scopeEn: Official catalogue confirms May2006 guidance and lock hydraulics; it is not treated as a gate structural-design standard.
lock-hydraulics.evidence: Official indexed results turn199search0 and turn199search48; publication date May1,2006.

lock-valves.title: 船閘廊道閥門水理設計手冊
lock-valves.titleEn: Hydraulic Design of Lock Culvert Valves EM1110-2-1610
lock-valves.scope: 官方書目列二〇一八年九月船閘充排水控制閥手冊；本課孔口係數是合成示意，非手冊指定值。
lock-valves.scopeEn: Official catalogue lists September2018 guidance for filling/emptying valves; the lesson discharge coefficient is synthetic, not a prescribed manual value.
lock-valves.evidence: Official indexed turn199search7 confirms September30,2018 and scope.

panama-basins.title: 巴拿馬節水池首次蓄水試驗
panama-basins.titleEn: First Panama Canal Water-Saving Basin Filled, Testing Process Begins
panama-basins.scope: 二〇一六年二月主管機關記錄阿瓜克拉拉試驗與兩組新船閘共十八池；再用比例與舊船閘比較分母不同。
panama-basins.scopeEn: February2016 owner release records Agua Clara testing and eighteen basins across the new locks; the reuse fraction has a different denominator from the comparison with old locks.

panama-opening.title: 巴拿馬擴建運河啟用
panama-opening.titleEn: Inauguration of the Expanded Panama Canal
panama-opening.scope: 官方二〇一六年啟用紀錄提供新船閘背景；不將本課合成面積與水位冒充巴拿馬實測。
panama-opening.scopeEn: Official2016 inauguration account provides project context; synthetic areas and levels here are not presented as Panama measurements.
panama-opening.evidence: Official indexed turn199search13 and turn199search21 confirm June26,2016 inauguration.

limits: Numerical models are declared original synthetic assumptions, not project field values.
